The '''Alderaan consular gardens''' were [[Garden/Legends|gardens]] attached to the [[Alderaanian Embassy|Alderaan consulate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="spero">{{WEGCite|story=Spero's Flight|book=Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook}}</ref>

They contained beds of [[Ancathian funge-flower]]s.<ref name="spero" />

Shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], they were tended by [[Master Gardener]] [[Spero]].<ref name="spero" />

[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] was a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizer and allowed Rebel operatives to use the garden as a meeting place; however they used the main planter as a drop point without her approval. The [[Alderaan consulate chief]] hid a [[Datacard/Legends|datacard]] in the main planter, which put Spero in trouble.<ref name="spero" />
